description: This file is the main entry point for a Flutter-based attendance tracking app. It initializes environment variables, ensures they are loaded correctly, and launches the root widget which displays some configuration details.

classes.name: AttendanceApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Attendance app, builds the main MaterialApp widget displaying configuration info.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Asynchronous main function that initializes Flutter bindings, loads environment variables, and runs the AttendanceApp.

methods.name: AttendanceApp.build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the app, showing environment variables loaded from AppConfig.
